research_gates.title: Skew Structure
research_gates.hypothesis: Short-end SPY skew follows a stable power-law term structure across maturities.
research_gates.verdict: Weak / partial support: cross-sectional power-law shape is present, but fitted slope is materially above the original rough-vol H prior.
research_gates.decision_rule: Promote only if slope stability survives a longer panel and produces tradable forecast value, not just descriptive fit.
research_gates.next_action: Re-estimate H-implied slope on a larger SPY panel and compare against fixed-H priors.

research_gates.title: Raw Rough Temporal Forecast
research_gates.hypothesis: Raw rough structural forecasts beat naive carry on one-step-ahead smile prediction.
research_gates.verdict: Rejected: latest robustness sweep shows 0/30 evaluable cells passing; raw rough loses to carry at 1-5 minute horizons.
research_gates.decision_rule: Keep rejected unless a materially different feature transform beats carry out of sample.
research_gates.next_action: Do not wire raw rough forecast into alpha_runner; retain only as a negative control.

research_gates.title: Regime Dynamics
research_gates.hypothesis: Raw rough may add value after large spot or forward moves even if it loses unconditionally.
research_gates.verdict: Narrow support: only a daily-ish skew signal survived in stressed regimes.
research_gates.decision_rule: Promote only if active-regime lift persists after fair scoring and transaction-cost-aware replay.
research_gates.next_action: Turn the surviving active-regime condition into a sizing overlay candidate.

research_gates.title: Incremental Edge Over Carry
research_gates.hypothesis: Rough geometry improves carry rather than replacing it.
research_gates.verdict: Pass: 24/30 cells pass, mainly on smile curvature; rough_cond_carry leads short horizons and rough_recent leads 60 minutes.
research_gates.decision_rule: Promote curvature carry correction after it is replayed as a strategy component with cost-aware PnL attribution.
research_gates.next_action: Implement a registry-backed candidate for bf25 rough-conditioned carry in alpha_runner or the experiment orchestrator.

research_gates.title: Edge Concentration
research_gates.hypothesis: Gate 4 improvement is stronger in ACTIVE than QUIET regimes.
research_gates.verdict: Weak / narrow support: only 6/42 cells pass at move_pct=30%, all in 5-minute bf25 rough_cond_carry.
research_gates.decision_rule: Do not claim stress-specific alpha unless active lift improves across more horizons and thresholds.
research_gates.next_action: Keep as a conditional sizing hypothesis, not a standalone alpha.

research_gates.title: Calendar / Term-Structure Vol Carry
research_gates.hypothesis: Front-versus-back SPY implied-vol term structure contains tradable roll-down and event-risk information.
research_gates.verdict: Planned candidate: not yet implemented because the current local panel focuses on one ATM expiry plus 25-delta smile points.
research_gates.decision_rule: Promote only after multi-expiry schema support and a carry-versus-realised term-structure benchmark.
research_gates.next_action: Extend the data contract to retain multiple expiries per timestamp before strategy work.

research_gates.title: Vol-of-Vol Regime Filter
research_gates.hypothesis: Changes in smile width and curvature stability can gate when variance carry should be reduced.
research_gates.verdict: Planned candidate using SSVI phi, bf25, and realised vol-of-vol proxies.
research_gates.decision_rule: Promote only if it reduces drawdown or tail losses without eliminating most VRP carry.
research_gates.next_action: Add a research sweep comparing composite strategy PnL with and without vol-of-vol regime sizing.

research_gates.title: Event-Risk Filter
research_gates.hypothesis: Scheduled macro/event windows explain part of extreme realised-vol spikes and should gate short-vol or carry exposure.
research_gates.verdict: Planned candidate; requires external event calendar input and is not part of the SPY-only local panel yet.
research_gates.decision_rule: Promote only after adding an event-calendar data contract and showing improved cost-aware replay metrics.
research_gates.next_action: Define an event-calendar dataset schema before implementing the signal.
